fixtures.text: Recall is a stateless Streamable HTTP MCP server. Its public health endpoint is /v1/health and its MCP endpoint is /v1/mcp.
Semantic retrieval filters by appId before Firestore nearest-neighbor vector search, so results stay within the requested project namespace.
Recall generates 1536-dimensional Gemini embeddings when a memory is saved and when a semantic query is retrieved.
The default test suite is cloud-free: it disables Secret Manager import and does not initialize ADC, Firestore, or Google embedding clients.
Use getMemories only for an explicit full-project audit. Omit the cursor for the first page, relay the server-issued nextCursor unchanged, and stop when it is null.
Before saving a durable candidate fact, retrieve the top 5 to 10 comparable memories, then choose add, no-op for a clear duplicate, or save-and-verify a replacement before deleting obsolete memory.
Recall deployments use Cloud Run and Cloud Build with application-level bearer authentication for the MCP endpoint.
